Description: Sequential fresh kernels; one warmup and one measured observation per variant per kernel; three kernels, alternating order. Coefficient-only and masters have different output bases. Native printtimes separates recurrence from subsequent assembly and output at 0.01 second resolution. FORMSeconds includes process handling and the same timing wrapper in every configuration. FORMPeakRSSKiB is the OS-reported FORM process high-water mark via /usr/bin/time. ProcessMeasurements records sampled Wolfram kernel RSS, not child processes. KernelBytes is retained Wolfram memory after reconstruction, not RSS. Large trials monitor TFORM directly. Initial malformed-number measurements were excluded after fixing import, not classified as performance successes.
